articles.title: Friendship Day 2026 — First Sunday of August (2 August)
articles.title_hi: मित्रता दिवस 2026 — अगस्त का पहला रविवार (2 अगस्त)
articles.summary: India observes Friendship Day on the first Sunday of August. In 2026 it falls on 2 August, distinct from the UN International Day of Friendship on 30 July.
articles.summary_hi: भारत अगस्त के पहले रविवार को मित्रता दिवस मनाता है। 2026 में यह 2 अगस्त को है, जो 30 जुलाई के UN अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मित्रता दिवस से अलग है।
articles.content:
In India, Friendship Day is popularly celebrated on the first Sunday of August. In 2026, it falls on 2 August. This is separate from the United Nations' International Day of Friendship, observed on 30 July since 2011.

The commercial observance gained popularity in India from the late 1990s. For exams, remember both dates: UN — 30 July; India (popular) — first Sunday of August.

For IB ACIO: India Friendship Day 2026 — 2 August; UN Friendship Day — 30 July.
articles.content_hi:
India Friendship Day: अगस्त का पहला रविवार (2026 — 2 Aug)। UN International Day of Friendship: 30 July (2011)।

IB ACIO: दोनों तिथियां — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: 2026 में भारत में मित्रता दिवस (अगस्त का पहला रविवार) कब है?
articles.explanation: The first Sunday of August 2026 is 2 August.
articles.explanation_hi: अगस्त 2026 का पहला रविवार 2 अगस्त है।

articles.title: CWG 2026 Closing Ceremony — Glasgow Hosts Compact 10-Sport Games
articles.title_hi: CWG 2026 समापन समारोह — ग्लासगो ने 10 खेलों का कॉम्पैक्ट खेल आयोजित किया
articles.summary: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games closed on 2 August with 215 medal events across 10 sports, marking the first Games under King Charles III as Head of the Commonwealth.
articles.summary_hi: ग्लासगो 2026 राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2 अगस्त को 10 खेलों में 215 पदक कार्यक्रमों के साथ संपन्न हुए, जो राष्ट्रमंडल के प्रमुख के रूप में राजा चार्ल्स III के under पहले खेल थे।
articles.content:
The XXIII Commonwealth Games at Glasgow closed on 2 August 2026 (Day 10) with a ceremony at a central venue. The compact Games featured 10 sports and 215 medal events, down from previous editions, as part of a future-proofing model.

The final day delivered 15 gold medals in netball, track cycling, bowls, and judo. Australia topped the medal table, followed by England and Canada. India finished among the top five nations.

For IB ACIO: Glasgow 2026, 23 July–2 August, 10 sports, 215 events, closing 2 August.
articles.content_hi:
CWG 2026: Glasgow, 23 July–2 Aug। 10 sports, 215 events। Closing — 2 Aug (Day 10, 15 golds)।

articles.title: India's CWG 2026 Medal Tally — Best Compact-Games Performance
articles.title_hi: भारत का CWG 2026 पदक tally — कॉम्पैक्ट खेलों में सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन
articles.summary: India concluded Glasgow 2026 with one of its strongest Commonwealth Games performances in the compact format, led by athletics, boxing, weightlifting, and para-athletics.
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने ग्लासगो 2026 को athletics, boxing, weightlifting और para-athletics के नेतृत्व में कॉम्पैक्ट प्रारूप में अपने सबसे मजबूत राष्ट्रमंडल खेल प्रदर्शनों में से एक के साथ समाप्त किया।
articles.content:
India's Glasgow 2026 campaign ended on 2 August with a strong medal haul across athletics (including Neeraj Chopra's javelin gold), boxing, weightlifting, para-athletics (Dilip Gavit's 100m T47 gold), and swimming.

Key performers included Mirabai Chanu (weightlifting), para-athletes, and the boxing contingent. The compact 10-sport format reduced total events but increased medal density per athlete.

For IB ACIO: India CWG 2026 — athletics, boxing, weightlifting, para-athletics highlights.
articles.content_hi:
India CWG 2026 highlights: Neeraj Chopra (javelin), Dilip Gavit (100m T47), Mirabai Chanu (weightlifting), boxing cluster।

articles.title: WHO Declares End of Mpox Public Health Emergency in Africa Region
articles.title_hi: WHO ने अफ्रीका क्षेत्र में Mpox सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य आपात समाप्त घोषित किया
articles.summary: The WHO announced the end of the mpox public health emergency of international concern for the Africa region after sustained decline in cases and expanded vaccination coverage.
articles.summary_hi: WHO ने मामलों में निरंतर गिरावट और विस्तृत टीकाकरण कवरेज के बाद अफ्रीका क्षेत्र के लिए mpox सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य अंतर्राष्ट्रीय चिंता आपात समाप्त घोषित किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the World Health Organisation (WHO) declared an end to the mpox PHEIC (Public Health Emergency of International Concern) status for the Africa region, citing declining transmission and improved surveillance.

Mpox (formerly monkeypox) is caused by an orthopoxvirus. WHO maintains global monitoring through the International Health Regulations (2005). India continues border screening under Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP).

For IB ACIO: WHO, mpox, PHEIC, IHR 2005, IDSP.
articles.content_hi:
WHO: mpox PHEIC ended (Africa region, Aug 2026)। IHR 2005। India — IDSP screening।

IB ACIO: WHO mpox — याद रखें।
articles.question: Global health emergencies under WHO are governed by which international framework?
articles.question_hi: WHO के तहत वैश्विक स्वास्थ्य आपात किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ढांचे से संचालित होते हैं?
articles.explanation: WHO uses the International Health Regulations (2005) to declare and manage public health emergencies.
articles.explanation_hi: WHO सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य आपात घोषित और प्रबंधित करने हेतु International Health Regulations (2005) का उपयोग करता है।

articles.title: SEBI Tightens Algorithmic Trading Norms for Retail Investors
articles.title_hi: SEBI ने खुदरा निवेशकों के लिए एल्गोरिद्मिक ट्रेडिंग मानदंड सख्त किए
articles.summary: SEBI issued revised norms requiring registration, audit trails, and kill-switch mechanisms for retail algo trading platforms, effective from October 2026.
articles.summary_hi: SEBI ने खुदरा algo trading प्लेटफॉर्म के लिए पंजीकरण, audit trail और kill-switch तंत्र अनिवार्य करते revised norms जारी किए, प्रभावी अक्टूबर 2026 से।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) tightened regulations on algorithmic trading for retail investors. All retail algo providers must register with exchanges, maintain audit trails, and implement kill-switch mechanisms to halt runaway orders.

The move follows concerns over flash crashes and unregulated third-party algo tools. Institutional algos remain under existing exchange frameworks.

For IB ACIO: SEBI, algo trading norms 2026, kill-switch, retail registration.
articles.content_hi:
SEBI algo norms (Aug 2026): retail registration, audit trail, kill-switch। प्रभावी — Oct 2026।

IB ACIO: SEBI algo — याद रखें।
articles.question: SEBI's revised algorithmic trading norms for retail investors, announced in August 2026, mandate which safety feature?
articles.question_hi: अगस्त 2026 में घोषित SEBI के revised algo trading norms में कौन सी सुरक्षा सुविधा अनिवार्य है?
articles.explanation: SEBI mandates kill-switch mechanisms to halt runaway algorithmic orders.

articles.title: Dr V Narayanan Appointed Chairman, ISRO
articles.title_hi: डॉ. वी. नारायणन को ISRO अध्यक्ष नियुक्त
articles.summary: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet appointed Dr V Narayanan, former Director of Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, as Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation.
articles.summary_hi: मंत्रिमंडल की नियुक्ति समिति ने पूर्व विक्रम साराभाई अंतरिक्ष केंद्र निदेशक डॉ. वी. नारायणन को भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) का अध्यक्ष नियुक्त किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the ACC appointed Dr V Narayanan as Chairman of ISRO and Secretary, Department of Space. He succeeded the previous chairman and brings extensive experience in launch vehicle propulsion from VSSC, Thiruvananthapuram.

His tenure will oversee Gaganyaan crewed missions, Chandrayaan follow-ups, and the NISAR satellite launch with NASA.

For IB ACIO: ISRO Chairman — Dr V Narayanan, ex-VSSC Director, August 2026.
articles.content_hi:
ISRO Chairman — Dr V Narayanan (Aug 2026), ex-VSSC Director। Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan, NISAR pipeline।

IB ACIO: Narayanan ISRO — याद रखें।

articles.title: India's First Indigenous Hydrogen Fuel-Cell Bus Fleet Launched in Delhi-NCR
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली-NCR में भारत का पहला स्वदेशी हाइड्रोजन फ्यूल-सेल बस बेड़ा शुरू
articles.summary: NTPC and Tata Motors launched a pilot fleet of 50 hydrogen fuel-cell electric buses in Delhi-NCR under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
articles.summary_hi: NTPC और Tata Motors ने राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन के तहत दिल्ली-NCR में 50 हाइड्रोजन फ्यूल-सेल इलेक्ट्रिक बसों का पायलट बेड़ा शुरू किया।
articles.content:
In August 2026, NTPC and Tata Motors launched India's first large-scale indigenous hydrogen fuel-cell bus pilot in Delhi-NCR. The 50-bus fleet operates on green hydrogen produced at NTPC's Faridabad facility.

The project aligns with the National Green Hydrogen Mission (approved 2023) targeting 5 MMT annual green hydrogen production by 2030. Fuel-cell buses emit only water vapour.

For IB ACIO: Green Hydrogen Mission 2023, NTPC-Tata, fuel-cell buses, Delhi-NCR pilot.
articles.content_hi:
Hydrogen fuel-cell buses: NTPC + Tata, Delhi-NCR, 50 buses। National Green Hydrogen Mission (2023), target 5 MMT by 2030।

articles.title: Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign 2026 Launched Ahead of Independence Day
articles.title_hi: स्वतंत्रता दिवस से पहले हर घर तिरंगा अभियान 2026 शुरू
articles.summary: The Ministry of Culture relaunched the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign for 13–15 August 2026, encouraging households to hoist the national flag for India's 80th Independence Day.
articles.summary_hi: संस्कृति मंत्रालय ने 13-15 अगस्त 2026 के लिए 'Har Ghar Tiranga' अभियान पुनः शुरू किया, जो भारत के 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस पर घरों में राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराने को प्रोत्साहित करता है।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Ministry of Culture relaunched 'Har Ghar Tiranga' for 13–15 August, ahead of the 80th Independence Day on 15 August 2026. Citizens are encouraged to hoist the tricolour at homes and upload selfies on the official portal.

The campaign was first launched in 2022 under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav. Flag Code of India permits display of the national flag by members of the public throughout the year, revised in 2022.

For IB ACIO: Har Ghar Tiranga, 13-15 Aug 2026, 80th Independence Day, Ministry of Culture.
articles.content_hi:
Har Ghar Tiranga 2026: 13-15 Aug। 80th Independence Day — 15 Aug 2026। Ministry of Culture। Flag Code revised 2022।

IB ACIO: Har Ghar Tiranga — याद रखें।

articles.explanation: India's 80th Independence Day is on 15 August 2026 (1947 + 79 years = 80th anniversary).

articles.title: India Elected to UN Commission on Limits of Continental Shelf for 2027-32
articles.title_hi: भारत UN Continental Shelf सीमा आयोग के लिए 2027-32 हेतु चुना गया
articles.summary: India was elected to the UN Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf (CLCS) for the 2027-2032 term, strengthening its maritime boundary and seabed claims process.
articles.summary_hi: भारत UN Continental Shelf सीमा आयोग (CLCS) के 2027-2032 कार्यकाल हेतु चुना गया, जो समुद्री सीमा और seabed claims प्रक्रिया को मजबूत करता है।
articles.content:
In August 2026, India was elected to the UN Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf (CLCS) for 2027-2032. CLCS examines submissions by coastal states on the outer limits of their continental shelf beyond 200 nautical miles under UNCLOS.

India has submitted claims in the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal. The election supports India's blue economy and deep-seabed exploration interests.

For IB ACIO: CLCS, UNCLOS, India elected 2027-32, continental shelf beyond 200 NM.
articles.content_hi:
CLCS: India elected 2027-32। UNCLOS framework, continental shelf beyond 200 NM। Claims — Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal।

IB ACIO: CLCS India — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: UN Continental Shelf सीमा आयोग (CLCS) किस convention के तहत कार्य करता है?
articles.explanation: CLCS operates under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
articles.explanation_hi: CLCS UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) के तहत कार्य करता है।

articles.title: Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme (DILRMP) 3.0 Launched
articles.title_hi: Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme (DILRMP) 3.0 शुरू
articles.summary: The Department of Land Resources launched DILRMP 3.0 to integrate land records with Aadhaar-based authentication, GIS mapping, and bank-linked property transactions.
articles.summary_hi: भूमि संसाधन विभाग ने DILRMP 3.0 शुरू किया, जो भूमि रिकॉर्ड को Aadhaar authentication, GIS mapping और बैंक-लिंक्ड संपत्ति लेनदेन से एकीकृत करेगा।
articles.content:
In August 2026, the Department of Land Resources (Ministry of Rural Development) launched DILRMP 3.0, upgrading the Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme. The phase integrates RoR (Record of Rights) with GIS, Aadhaar authentication, and bank pass-through for mutation and loan processing.

Over 94% of villages had computerised land records under earlier phases. DILRMP 3.0 targets 100% integration with the Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (ULPIN / Bhu-Aadhaar).

For IB ACIO: DILRMP 3.0, ULPIN/Bhu-Aadhaar, Department of Land Resources.
articles.content_hi:
DILRMP 3.0: Land Resources Dept। ULPIN/Bhu-Aadhaar integration, GIS, Aadhaar auth।

IB ACIO: DILRMP, ULPIN — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (ULPIN) को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
articles.explanation: ULPIN is popularly known as Bhu-Aadhaar — a 14-digit unique ID for land parcels.
